Edit a test case

Usage: papyrus test-case edit [OPTIONS] <ID>

Arguments:
  <ID>  

Options:
      --json                           Emit stable, machine-readable JSON.
      --title <TITLE>                  Update the title
      --description <DESCRIPTION>      Use "-" to read multiline text from standard input.
      --dir <path>                     Project directory. Default: the current working directory.
      --applicability <APPLICABILITY>  Update the applicability (empty clears it)
      --config <file>                  Configuration file. Default: papyrus.config.yml in the project directory.
      --editor                         Open the document body in $VISUAL or $EDITOR
      --no-color                       Disable ANSI color output.
      --label <LABEL>                  Label
      --reference <REFERENCE>          Reference
  -h, --help                           Print help
